definitions.explanation: A public event or showing to announce and display a completed work, building, or product. Most commonly used for film premieres and building completion ceremonies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}⟦{試写会|ししゃかい}→試写会：20376_shishakai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A premiere screening of the film was held.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}→招待：01435_shoutai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was invited to the completion unveiling party for the new building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{主演|しゅえん}→主演：08254_shuen⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}⟦{舞台挨拶|ぶたいあいさつ}→舞台挨拶：22303_butaiaisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登壇|とうだん}→登壇：13691_toudan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The director and lead actor appeared at the premiere stage greeting.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧ (completion) and ⟦{披露|ひろう}→披露：09683_hirou⟧ (public announcement; unveiling). Most frequently used in the entertainment industry for film and drama premieres.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}⟦{試写会|ししゃかい}→試写会：20376_shishakai⟧: premiere screening
- {完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}⟦{上映|じょうえい}→上映：08380_jouei⟧: premiere showing
- {完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}⟦{舞台挨拶|ぶたいあいさつ}→舞台挨拶：22303_butaiaisatsu⟧: premiere stage greeting
- {完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧: premiere press conference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{初公開|はつこうかい}→初公開：18413_hatsukoukai⟧: first public showing — more general, used for any type of first reveal
- ⟦お{披露目|ひろめ}→お披露目：19095_ohirome⟧: debut; unveiling — broader, used for introducing people, products, and events
- プレミア⟦{上映|じょうえい}→上映：08380_jouei⟧: premiere screening (loanword) — the film industry loanword alternative
